rendered:
The Mn-substituted LNO cathode with 10%[1] Mn delivers 212 mAh g[2] of discharge capacity, while the cathode with 50%[3] Mn delivers 164 mAh g[4]. The text attributes the lower capacity at higher Mn content to the electrochemical inactivity of the Mn ions, even though higher Mn improves cycling stability.

Source: the discussion of Fig. Fig. 4[5]
